en.title: Memories of Silver Snow, or the Requiem of the Vanished Village
en.premise: A weathered photograph and an address‑less letter, found deep in a closet, reveal the forgotten story of a "lost village" erased from maps and the secret ice chamber—known as the "Ice Castle"—that the narrator’s grandfather built in secret. The memoir traces lost time and a forbidden love, inviting readers into a haunting recollection of hidden histories.

zh.title: 银雪的记忆，或消失村庄的挽歌
zh.premise: 一张发黄的照片和一封没有收件人的信，藏在壁橱深处，揭示了曾被地图抹去的“失落村庄”的记忆，以及祖父秘密建造的“冰城”——一座冰室的秘密。回忆录追溯失去的时光与禁忌之恋，带领读者踏入隐藏历史的幽暗回响。
